titulo.estudio: Lire une consigne de santé : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Reading health instructions: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Understand frequency, duration and precautions in a general health recommendation. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Understand frequency, duration and precautions in a general health recommendation. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: « Depuis », « pendant » and « avant de » show duration and order; do not turn a general recommendation into a diagnosis. In this passage, «notice» means «leaflet».

frases.estudio: Le traitement dure cinq jours; il faut lire les précautions avant de commencer.
frases.alumno: The treatment lasts five days; you must read the precautions before starting.

frases.estudio: Évitez de conduire si le médicament provoque de la somnolence.
frases.alumno: Avoid driving if the medicine causes drowsiness.

frases.estudio: La notice indique de prendre un comprimé après le repas, deux fois par jour.
frases.alumno: The leaflet says to take one tablet after a meal, twice a day.
